Team — I reviewed LuminaWorks' redlines. Summary and recommended positions below (keeping in mind we want the partner but must protect production SLA and customer data):

1) DPA scope & retention
- Request: They want telemetry + embeddings to be explicitly covered for support/analytics with retention up to 5 years.
- Our position: Accept processing for troubleshooting and aggregated analytics, but limit retention to 13 months for session-level telemetry. Embeddings derived from customer content should be covered only where customer has consented; we should prohibit retention beyond 24 months unless customer consents in writing.
- Suggested wording: "Redwood will store telemetry and derived data for operational purposes for a period not to exceed 13 months, except where customer consent permits longer retention for embeddings (max 24 months)."

2) Indemnity and liability cap
- Request: LuminaWorks wants mutual indemnity carve-outs for IP when they process customer data.
- Our position: Mutual indemnity is acceptable but we must exclude claims arising from breach of our platform or negligence. Propose a liability cap at 12 months of fees (not 24). If they insist on 24 months, ask for reciprocal concessions (wider audit limits / additional security attestations).
- Suggested wording: "Liability shall be limited to the greater of (i) direct damages up to an amount equal to fees paid in the 12 months preceding the claim or (ii) statutory minimums. Neither party shall be liable for indirect, consequential damages."

3) Subprocessors & notifications
- Request: 10-day objection window for new subprocessors.
- Our position: Standard 30-day notice with ability to object for material reasons; we cannot agree to a 10-day window operationally.

4) Audit rights
- Request: SOC2 + potential on-site review.
- Our position: Provide SOC2 report and third-party penetration test summaries. On-site reviews will be limited and require advance notice and scope approval; prefer virtual evidence review.

Next steps for Karthik: please share the above back to LuminaWorks as our initial counter-proposal. If they accept 12-month cap and limited audit scope, legal can turn around clean DPA language within 3 business days.

Attachments: internal notes (not attached to external thread).
